title: County benefits backlog
accepted_explanation: The agency simply needs a larger budget.
observations: Incoming cases exceed completed cases during seasonal peaks.
Specialist review is required late in the sequence.
Work is batched before specialist review.
Backlog persists after temporary staff are added to intake.
participant_claims: Managers say chronic underfunding explains the backlog.
researcher_interpretations: Capacity and sequencing at a constrained stage may jointly sustain backlog.
assumptions: Any additional headcount will increase throughput proportionally.
